# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

## Breaking Changes

- **User name field split:** The `name` field on `/v2/users` is now two separate fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. Requests sending `name` will be rejected. Update your payloads and any code that reads the response.

## New Features

- **Incremental transfers:** Pass `--incremental` to sync only rows changed since the last run. Uses server-side change tracking where available; falls back to timestamp comparison. Dramatically reduces transfer time on large, append-heavy tables.

## Performance

- **Parquet writes are 40% faster.** Column encoding and dictionary compression now run in parallel, cutting write time on wide tables significantly. No configuration changes needed — upgrade and the speedup applies automatically.

---

Upgrade guide: update all clients reading `/v2/users` before deploying. The `--incremental` flag is opt-in; existing pipelines are unaffected.
